players.product: Hyperscale AI data-center campus with behind-the-meter power (Project Matador, Texas): powered land, powered shell and turnkey data centers leased to AI compute tenants (first tenant TensorWave, 222 MW initial phase)

quarterly_data.signal: Fermi's July 2026 investor presentation (8-K exhibit, information as of March 31, 2026) lays out its generation portfolio, excluding Xcel Energy grid power: three Siemens SGT6-5000F units, 726 MW simple cycle / 1,047 MW combined cycle, purchased, 22 months to power (EPC contract in negotiation; GT #1 and #2 complete and in transit to the Port of Houston, GT #3 in final assembly in Germany, estimated delivery to site Q3 2026); seven GE TM2500 units, 124 MW, on a 20-year lease, 2 months to power (held by the lessor until June 2027); six Siemens SGT-800 units, 294 MW simple / 394MW combined, purchased, 15 months to power (all in the Port of Houston and cleared by customs); three GE Vernova FR6B units, 114 MW, purchased, 8 months to power (refurbishment complete). Targets: power of 1.5 GW in 2027 and 2 GW in 2028 (up to 1.5GW by YE2027), up to 17 GW long term (11 GW gas, 6 GW nuclear); a 6GW federal air permit secured and an application for an additional 5GW filed; 220 MMBtu/d firm gas supply secured; approximately 7,570 acres secured or under contract.
quarterly_data.figure: SGT6-5000F 726 MW / 1,047 MW; TM2500 124 MW; SGT-800 294 MW / 394MW; FR6B 114 MW; 1.5 GW 2027, 2 GW 2028; 6GW air permit

quarterly_data.signal: Fermi's July 2026 business update (8-K): it had preliminary discussions with seven potential tenants and twelve potential joint venture partners over the last several months, with more advanced negotiations ongoing with a smaller number of counterparties, and expected to sign its first binding JV partner and/or tenant agreement in Q3 2026. Execution partners: a signed service agreement with TSK (which Fermi calls Spain's largest power-focused EPC firm) for early-works engineering on the three Siemens SGT6-5000F turbines, and an agreement with Primoris to engineer and construct balance of plant for the first six SGT-800 turbines (excavation complete for all six power islands), with a final EPC agreement for the simple-cycle phase targeted.
quarterly_data.figure: seven potential tenants and twelve potential JV partners; first binding agreement expected Q3 2026
